connects_to.relationship: T-cell engager platform licensed for multi-specific antibody discovery

contracts.signal: Customer-side confirmation from Jazz. CEO Renee Gala: 'our preclinical research collaboration with AbCellera, which leverages their T-cell engager platform to discover novel multi-specific antibodies. This agreement directly complements our oncology expertise and supports our refined rare disease strategy.' In Q&A she added that it is 'a preclinical collaboration looking at next-gen T-cell engagers, very early in our pipeline, but it directly aligns with our overall rare disease strategy, really expanding our focus on GI cancers.' CFO Phil Johnson cited it as the most recent example of disciplined capital deployment.
